name: instl
description: A CLI tool for installing files with LTSV recipe support
author: sasa+1 <sasaplus1@gmail.com>

scripts.build: pnpm run build:script && pnpm run build:binary
scripts.build:script: bun build src/index.ts --outfile dist/index.js --target node --packages external
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:biome && pnpm run lint:tsc
scripts.test: pnpm run test:node && pnpm run test:bun
